summary.en: A darker surface for furniture designs with a defined colour palette.
summary.zh: 为需要深色表面的家具设计提供选材方向。

description.en:
A dark-faced panel option for furniture and interior components. Confirm the colour, surface texture and board thickness together so the visible finish works with the rest of your project.
Ask for a current sample when matching this panel with edging or adjoining materials.
description.zh:
面向家具与室内部件的深色饰面板选项。建议同时确认颜色、表面质感和厚度，使可见表面与项目其他材料协调。
如需配套封边或相邻材料，可通过当前样品核对。

en: Dark decorative surface shown in the supplied photograph.
Coordinate the board colour with edging and other components.
Confirm thickness and the required surface specification.
zh: 配图展示深色装饰表面。
可结合封边及其他部件一起核对颜色。
厚度与所需表面配置另行确认。

applications.en: Furniture and interior panels, subject to the selected specification.
applications.zh: 家具及室内板材，具体按所选规格确认。

value.en: Confirm by specification and order mix
value.zh: 按规格及订单组合确认

value.en: Request current sample terms and production schedule
value.zh: 询价时确认样品条件及当前排产
